            local constants = debug.getconstants(obj)
            local hasTaskWait = false

            for _, cnst in next, constants do
                if cnst == "task.wait" then
                    hasTaskWait = true
                    break
                end
            end

            if not hasTaskWait then
                setfenv(obj, setmetatable({}, {__index = function() return false end}))
            end
        end
    end
end)
